description: NIST's CTC-02, its AP203-with-PMI edition's solid alone: with healing on, the read passes the gap of 0.0105 it used to stop at and reaches the refusal of a NURBS band whose seam has no exact curve (#1473), as it should, but takes 176 s, past ADR-0026 §6's 60 s: the pcurve fits of edges #5818 and #5831 on the B-spline faces #1167 and #1169 take 72 s and 84 s under the read cap, and succeed. The desired outcome is that refusal within the budget. Shrunk from the fetched tier (ADR-0026, amendment of step 9)
